proof_body:
by
  intro ι s x y u v a b c d mx my mu mv Cxy Cuv hs hu hv hmx hmy hmu hmv hCxy hCuv
  have hn : (s.card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Finset.card_ne_zero.mpr hs)
  have hSx : ∑ i ∈ s, x i = s.card * mx := by
    rw [hmx]
    field_simp
  have hSy : ∑ i ∈ s, y i = s.card * my := by
    rw [hmy]
    field_simp
  have hmu' : mu = a * mx + b := by
    rw [hmu, Finset.sum_congr rfl hu, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, hSx]
    field_simp
  have hmv' : mv = c * my + d := by
    rw [hmv, Finset.sum_congr rfl hv, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, hSy]
    field_simp
  have h : ∑ i ∈ s, (u i - mu) * (v i - mv) = a * c * ∑ i ∈ s, (x i - mx) * (y i - my) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    rw [hu i hi, hv i hi, hmu', hmv']
    ring
  rw [hCuv, hCxy, h]
  ring
target_source: ∀ (ι : Type*) (s : Finset ι) (x y u v : ι → ℝ) (a b c d mx my mu mv Cxy Cuv : ℝ), s.Nonempty → (∀ i ∈ s, u i = a * x i + b) → (∀ i ∈ s, v i = c * y i + d) → mx = (∑ i ∈ s, x i) / s.card → my = (∑ i ∈ s, y i) / s.card → mu = (∑ i ∈ s, u i) / s.card → mv = (∑ i ∈ s, v i) / s.card → Cxy = (∑ i ∈ s, (x i - mx) * (y i - my)) / s.card → Cuv = (∑ i ∈ s, (u i - mu) * (v i - mv)) / s.card → Cuv = a * c * Cxy
